segments.he:
הצדיק ר' גרשון מווילעדניק ז"ל שהי' מאנ"ש והי' תלמיד חבר להרה"צ מווילעדניק ז"ל שהי' פרוש גדול מאד ולא הי' יכול להריח ריח אשה כלל והר' גרשון הי' ישן אתו) והי' מגודל מקטנותו אצל הרה"צ ר' לוי יצחק מבארדיטשוב ז"ל (ויש בזה מעשה לספר) והר' גרשון ז"ל הי' אצלו חביב מהכל ממש לא הי' יכול לחיות כלל בלעדו ואמר עליו (וכן אמרו עליו שאר כל העולם ואנשים) שהוא מלו' צדיקים ושאלו לר' גרשון מה הי' אם הי' אומר לו שלא תסעו לאומן, ענה ואמר אשיין פנים וואלט ער בא מיר גיהאט". והר' גרשון הנ"ל הי' אומר (הפזמון של אזמר בשבחין בליל ש"ק) 
רשימין וסתימין בגוי כל עלמין חסידי ברסלב רשימין גדייציריכייט וסתימין פאר הוילען בגוי כל עלמין פין אלע וועלטין. ברם עתיק יומין, ?? בא השי"ת אליין, הלא בטיש בטישין, עס קלאפט אין קלאפט. והר' גרשון הי' מספר כי הרה"צ מוולעדניק הנ"ל כשהי' אומר אשת חיל והי' מגיע לשקר החן והבל היופי הי' משליך הכסא הרבנות עד לדלת, ושאשתו היתה צועקת תמיד מדוע אתה מסתיר א"ע איך ווייס דאך יוא כי הוא הי' קדוש ופרוש גדול כנ"ל.
segments.en:
I heard from our fellowship that once Moharan'as was speaking together with the disciples of Rabbainu during his holy lifetime about the great awesomeness of Rabbainu's holiness. The famous Feiga — Rabbainu's mother — was passing by and overheard how they spoke of Rabbainu's holiness. She answered them: "Let me tell you what kind of Rebbe you have — and you will know his holiness and the holiness of his soul."

"My husband the holy Tzaddik Reb Simcha once traveled on a journey and was delayed about two weeks. He told me he would return home for Shabbos. On that very Shabbos he had promised to return, I rose before dawn to knead the holy challahs for Shabbos. While separating the challah portion I searched to see where he was — to know whether he would come home for Shabbos [for she was among those with prophetic gifts, as is known — her brother the holy Reb Baruch of Medzhibuzh called her a prophetess, and her holy brothers Reb Baruch and Reb Ephraim of Sadilkov showed her great reverence]. But I could not find him. Afterward when I did other Shabbos preparations, I searched again and could not find him — and so it was many times. [That night was also the night of her immersion. She considered whether to go, went, and searched then too — and could not find him.] And when I lit the Shabbos candles [it was her custom to light many hours before the required time], I searched again and could not see him. After lighting the candles I lay down on my bed from great distress — and dozed off."

"And my sainted mother Adel came to me together with all the Matriarchs — Sarah, Rivkah, Rachel, and Leah — and said to me: 'Do not grieve — your husband will still come home today, on Erev Shabbos.' They took me and led me to the Chamber of Souls. I saw a soul whose light was very great — and I asked them: 'Who is this soul?' They told me: 'This is the soul of your grandfather the Ba'al Shem Tov.' They then led me further and I saw a soul whose light was immeasurably greater — without measure. And I asked: 'Who is this soul?' They said: 'This soul they want to give you — and so forth.' I woke up immediately."

"And my husband arrived home from his journey. I asked him: 'What happened? I searched for you and could not find you anywhere.' He told me: on Friday morning he had set out and was about fifteen parsaos from Mezhibuzh — and wandered on the road the entire day. Toward evening he looked up and found himself near Mezhibuzh — and was greatly astonished. He came home while it was still full day. And that same night was the night of his immersion — and I conceived from him with my son, who is your Rebbe. From now on you can understand the greatness of your Rebbe and the holiness of his soul."
